errors.text: The stated VEC of approximately 8.0-8.5 is incorrect for equiatomic CoCrFeNiTi; using standard elemental VEC values gives approximately 7.4. This undermines the proposed VEC-based argument for a predominantly or single-phase FCC alloy.

The hypothesis reconstructs the desired structure as single-phase or dominant FCC with negligible HCP, whereas the target result is a mixed approximately 83% FCC/17% BCC solid solution. It therefore misidentifies the central phase-transition outcome.

Low-load Vickers testing by itself cannot isolate grain-boundary strengthening from precipitation hardening; phase- or precipitate-controlled specimens and quantitative microstructural comparisons are required.
